title: confined-file.v1
description: Confined file reference used by the path and mutation primitives. Resolved target stays inside its canonical root. Unsafe or changed identity refuses. Security maintainers approve changes; additive bounds may only tighten through a new grant; unknown versions refuse.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Additive bounds may only tighten through a new grant; unknown versions refuse.

canonical_root.description: Canonical (absolute, non-link, confirmed) root directory. The resolved path must remain inside this root.

relative_path.description: Repository-relative path from the canonical root. Must not be absolute or contain traversal segments.
